finalText:
Found it. Both logs point at the same worker path.

`processOrder.js` grabbed a connection directly and only released it after a successful run. When an order failed validation, `run` threw before the release line, so the connection was gone for good. The worker log shows that exact pattern — five straight `invalid order payload` failures, pool climbing to 5/5, then `pool exhausted`, then the worker giving up. The app log shows the same collapse on the API side, ending in a supervisor restart.

The API path (`api.js`) was fine — it already went through `withConnection`, which releases in a `finally`.

Fix: wrapped `processOrder`'s acquire/run in a `try/finally` so the connection always goes back, failure or not.

All 4 tests pass now (95ms). No other leak sites in the codebase.
